scientific_conditions: The Gaussian-bath NMQSD framework is formally exact; numerical nuHOPS uses finite adaptive hierarchy/basis and time steps. This is classical simulation of a collective spin coupled to a damped cavity, not a500qubit QPU.

At N=500 and paper time tprime=75/omega_a, reconstructed target population is (1.8+/-0.8)e-8 for Sz/S>=-0.6; a million brute-force trajectories have no target event. The uncertainty is one bootstrap standard deviation.
TPS updates independent Gaussian raw noise, restores correlated bath noise, and combines overlapping windows with WHAM. Correlation, burn-in, seed search and propagation are real computational costs.
NMQSD trajectories are auxiliary ensemble paths, not an individual experiment continuous record. The fixed-time probability and metastable-state population interpretation are explicit.
Matched trajectory counts do not prove equal wall-clock cost; seed trajectories add at most4percent in the rate comparison. OLED transfer is a proposal requiring an appropriate bath/coupling model.
